object: graffito, three straggling lines scratched on a column
site: Sûlib (Soleb), temple of Amenhotep III: western face of the middle column on the east side of the third court behind the pylon
notes: Length of top line 58 cm, height 22 cm; Lepsius squeezes, L., D., VI, Bl. 7, no. 25; Waddington and Hanbury. Griffith: the top line begins far to the right of the others; 'the lettering is very early; the forms of many of the letters are almost unintelligible, and no words can be definitely recognized as occurring elsewhere.' Griffith prints a hatched (damaged) sign with '?' at the end of l. 2 and at the start of l. 3, and a point with '?' after se in l. 2 and at the end of l. 3; each is written [.]. All four 3-shaped signs read m and the p/k pairs settled at 2.5x beside the sign table.
